hero.label: Institutional Network
hero.headline: Our Institutional Network
hero.subheadline: Gyanteerth's institutional network spans schools, colleges, and educational organisations across India — united by a shared commitment to academic excellence, professional development, and the advancement of education.

overview.heading: A National Network of Educational Institutions

body.text: Gyanteerth's institutional network is the foundation of the Society's work. Member institutions — ranging from primary schools to senior secondary institutions, from single-campus schools to large multi-branch educational groups — form a community of practice that collectively advances the quality and reach of education across India.

The network provides member institutions with access to Gyanteerth's full range of academic programmes, professional development resources, inter-institutional collaboration opportunities, and national recognition platforms. It also gives institutions a voice in the Society's governance and a stake in shaping the direction of Indian education.

institutionTypes.label: Who We Work With
institutionTypes.heading: Types of Member Institutions
institutionTypes.intro: Gyanteerth's network is open to a broad range of educational institutions and organisations committed to academic excellence.

types.title: Primary & Upper Primary Schools
types.description: Schools offering education from Class I through Class VIII, affiliated to any recognised board or operating under state government recognition.

types.title: Secondary & Senior Secondary Schools
types.description: Schools offering education through Class X and Class XII, affiliated to CBSE, ICSE, state boards, or other recognised examining bodies.

types.title: International & IB Schools
types.description: Schools offering internationally recognised curricula including the International Baccalaureate (IB), Cambridge (IGCSE/A Level), and other international programmes.

types.title: Residential & Boarding Schools
types.description: Residential schools and boarding institutions providing full-time residential education, including Navodaya Vidyalayas, Sainik Schools, and private residential institutions.

types.title: Educational Trusts & Societies
types.description: Registered educational trusts, societies, and foundations operating one or more educational institutions and committed to the advancement of education.

types.title: Educational Groups & Chains
types.description: Multi-campus educational groups and school chains seeking institutional membership for their network of schools under a single organisational umbrella.

partnerships.label: Partnerships
partnerships.heading: Institutional Partnerships
partnerships.body: Gyanteerth actively seeks partnerships with educational organisations, academic bodies, and institutions that share its commitment to educational excellence. Partnerships may take the form of programme collaboration, joint events, academic exchange, or formal institutional affiliation.

types.title: Academic Programme Partners
types.description: Institutions that co-design, co-deliver, or host Gyanteerth academic programmes, competitions, and examinations.

types.title: Host Institutions
types.description: Schools and educational organisations that serve as examination or event centres for Gyanteerth programmes in their region.

types.title: Knowledge Partners
types.description: Academic institutions, research organisations, and subject matter experts that contribute to the design and quality assurance of Gyanteerth's academic content.

types.title: Outreach Partners
types.description: Educational organisations and networks that support Gyanteerth's outreach to underserved geographies and communities.

hostInstitutions.label: Host Institutions
hostInstitutions.heading: Become a Host Institution
hostInstitutions.body: Host institutions play a vital role in Gyanteerth's programme delivery. By serving as examination or event centres, host institutions extend the Society's reach, support students and schools in their region, and strengthen their own institutional profile as a centre of academic excellence.

benefits.text: Official recognition as a Gyanteerth Host Institution
Priority access to Gyanteerth programmes and resources
Enhanced institutional visibility within the regional network
Dedicated support from the Society's regional coordination team
